bio: Mariam Kvashilava is a Georgian artist based in New York. Working across painting, drawing, printmaking, and mixed media, her work explores memory, identity, displacement, and belonging through layered imagery and intuitive mark-making. Born in Tbilisi, she studied Art History and Archaeology at the Sorbonne in Paris and received her MFA from the New York Academy of Art.
